label: accepted

evidence.V1: Front, three-quarter and top views read instantly as a round shield (gold rim ring, quartered field, steel boss; top shows rim edge, boss bulge and handle); the silhouette render is a near-plain ellipse with only faint rivet nubs, the weakest angle but still a shield disc.
evidence.V2: Clear hierarchy: big disc + thick gold rim, medium quartered field and large boss on an ink-dark flange, small 8 rivets evenly spaced on the rim.
evidence.V3: Chunky rim and oversized boss give a confident stylised read; boss dome is a fairly plain hemisphere but proportions sit well against the 2.7-stud disc.
evidence.V4: Rim shows a consistent chamfer catch-light stripe in the rim close-up; plate inset edge and boss flange edge are softened, no razor edges visible.
evidence.V5: Front/outline is symmetric (A15 X=0.0, Z=0.0, boss and rivet ring centred, all seats pass), but close-ups show stray faceting: rivets have clearly polygonal outlines, the boss outline is visibly segmented in the flat close-up, rim outer edge shows segment steps, and a light smudge on the teal plate just above the boss flange in the studio close-up.
evidence.V6: Disciplined: gold rim, warm cream + one hue (teal) quarters, steel-grey boss/rivets with ink flange; colourways (crimson, shadow) swap only the hue.
evidence.V7: 2400 tris vs weapon target 2500 (ceiling 4000), under target.
evidence.V8: One white vertex-colour material, kit gold/cream/steel/ink palette, chamfered rim and smooth shading match the HeaterShield kit look.
evidence.V9: Studio line correct: origin at handle/hand point, CollisionFidelity Box, CanCollide off when equipped, Massless, MeshPart.Color white, SmoothPlastic.

evidence.V7: 2,400 tris vs weapon target 2,500 (ceiling 4,000): at target.

evidence.V9: Studio line complete: origin at handle/grip point, CollisionFidelity Box, CanCollide off when equipped, Massless, MeshPart.Color white for vertex colours, SmoothPlastic.

evidence.V7: 2400 tris vs weapon target 2500 (ceiling 4000), at/under target.
evidence.V8: One white vertex-colour material, kit gold/ink/cream/steel palette with one hue, smooth shading and chamfered rim match the HeaterShield sibling; rivet density is a touch lower than the sibling but within kit look.
evidence.V9: Studio line correct: origin at handle/hand point, CollisionFidelity Box, CanCollide off when equipped, Massless, MeshPart.Color white for vertex colours, SmoothPlastic.
